## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link the related issue, if any.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results. State any skipped checks or known limitations.

## Screenshots or recording

Include these for interface changes. Use original sample text and remove personal information.

## Setup or migration

Describe any new configuration, dependency, database migration or content preparation step. Write “None” when this does not apply.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/holsoma/readlay/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
